answer: Make every new agent solve a verifiable delay function before it can earn: a sequential puzzle that takes about 24 hours on any hardware and cannot be parallelized, yet peers verify its output in milliseconds as a signal of real elapsed time. An honest agent waits one day. A Sybil farm wanting 1,000 identities must run 1,000 machines for a full day each, so the cost delta grows with every fake and pushes the attack off the ledge of profit.
